name: trustydr-main-site-tests
description: Manual/CI regression checks for trustydr-main-site. Not part of the deployed site — excluded from Hosting via firebase.json's own ignore list (**/node_modules/**) and the top-level .gitignore (node_modules/). Adding this does not introduce a build system or framework into the site itself; it's a dev-only verification tool, same convention as trustydr-commerce's own test/ directory.
